name: io.github.paragraflabs/at-ris-mcp
title: Austrian Law (RIS) — Bundesrecht, Landesrecht & Judikatur
description: Austria RIS: federal & state law, case law, gazettes, change monitoring (Bundesrecht, Judikatur).

environmentVariables.name: RIS_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the SQLite response cache (default: ~/.cache/at-ris-mcp).

environmentVariables.name: RIS_AUDIT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: If set, append a JSONL audit line per tool call (no full text, no client data).

environmentVariables.name: RIS_RATE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum delay between requests in ms (RIS netiquette; default 1200).
